subject: Renewal/Expansion: pricing step-ups, blended rates, new routes/models
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novahealth.com>, Claire Morgan <claire@novahealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — token volumes / pricing qualification

Hi Samir / Claire,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and a few asks so we can get you a formal proposal that lines up with NovaHealth's budget and usage patterns.

Call summary (high level)
- Primary use case: real-time patient triage + clinical note generation for inbound messages (mix of short prompts + longer summarization).
- Current baseline: ~40M tokens/month today across prod + staging. Expected growth to ~250-350M tokens/month over the next 12 months with the expansion of the clinical routing and a second model route for long-form summarization.
- Models/routes: want lower-cost route for short generation (q/weighed cheaper quantized model) and higher-quality route for summaries.
- SLOs: 200–300ms p50 on short route, <1s on long summaries where possible.

Action items for NovaHealth (so we can price accurately):
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly token ranges for Q4 and next year? You mentioned a conservative ~250M and stretch 350M — confirm if that’s accurate.
2) Budget/target unit economics: what is your target $/1M tokens (ballpark)? This helps us recommend blended rates vs committed step-ups.
3) Any constraints on contract term or PO timing (quarterly billing vs annual commit)?

Attached: we discussed sending a short usage CSV — feel free to reply with that export. I’ve also attached a short checklist of model routes we typically recommend.

Proposed next steps
- I’ll draft a pricing proposal with (a) volume step-up tiers, (b) blended rates for mixed-route usage, and (c) optional reserved capacity for predictable throughput.
- If that looks good, we can schedule a follow-up the week of Aug 31 to walk the numbers with your finance/procurement folks.

Thanks — and please include any other stakeholders who should see the proposal.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — appreciated the clear notes. Quick answers below and I attached the usage export you requested.

Q4 / 12-month volumes
- Q4 conservative: ~220–280M tokens/mo (we expect a big push in December).
- Next year (12-month run rate): planning for 300–375M tokens/mo as we roll out the second route.

Budget / target unit economics
- Our procurement target is in the range of $700–$1,100 per 1M tokens (this is rough — varies by model/route).
- For the high-quality summarization route we can tolerate up to $1,500/1M, but want the short/fast route closer to $700–$900/1M.

Contract timing
- Procurement prefers annual commit with quarterly invoices, but we can do monthly for the first 1–2 months while the contract completes. PO timeline: target sign by end of September.

Notes / attachments
- Attached: novahealth_usage_aug2026.csv (export from our analytics). It includes per-route token split (short-route ~75% of tokens today).

Happy to jump on a follow-up once you send a proposal. CC'ing Claire (Finance) for visibility.

Subject: Proposal (draft) — volume step-ups & blended rates for NovaHealth

Hi Samir / Claire,

Thanks for the usage file — super helpful. Based on the token split and your target ranges, attached is a short draft proposal (summary below). Please consider this a starting point; we can refine blended math after any third-party model choices or exact route percentages.

Proposal highlights (draft)
- Term: 12-month agreement with quarterly invoicing. Option A: committed step-ups; Option B: committed + reserved capacity for peak windows.
- Volume tiers (monthly tokens):
  * Tier 1: 0–100M — $1,100 / 1M tokens
  * Tier 2: 100–300M — $900 / 1M tokens
  * Tier 3: 300–600M — $700 / 1M tokens
- Blended example (current expected mix):
  * Short/fast route (~75% of tokens): priced at $800/1M (quantized model)
  * High-quality summary route (~25%): priced at $1,350/1M
  * Blended across 300M tokens: ((0.75*800)+(0.25*1350)) = $962.50 / 1M tokens (effective)
- Volume step-ups: we can add automatic step-up credits when you hit >350M for two consecutive months (5% discount on next tier) and offer a blended true-up at quarter close.
- Reserved capacity option: flat monthly fee to reserve a pool for low-latency peaks; pricing depends on peak concurrency — we’ll size once you share Q4 peak RPS.

Next steps
1) Confirm preferred option (A: tiered committed; B: committed + reserved).
2) If you want the reserved capacity quote, share expected peak RPS and percent of traffic requiring p50 <300ms.
3) We’ll produce a redline-ready contract and a one-page pricing worksheet for finance.

Attached: Redwood_Proposal_Q4_2026.pdf (draft).

If these numbers look in-line with your budget targets (I used $700–$1,350 bands based on our discussion), we can lock in a follow-up to walk the worksheet and finalize PO timing. I’ll schedule time for Aug 31 — feel free to propose a time.

Best,

Marissa Cole
